title: Quotient transport for the restriction localization chain
statement:
For schemes X and Y, a morphism h : X → Y, an open W of Y, and every cochain complex I of modules on X (with the derived-category universe assumptions below), the explicit restriction/localization chain [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-restriction-localization-chain] equals the homotopy restriction chain transported by the canonical quotient comparisons. The units are those of [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data], and the restriction comparison is [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-open-counit-model]. Exact statement:
theorem schemeMV_restriction_chain_quotient_transport
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let F := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom
    let G := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (h ∣_ W).toLRSHom.toShHom
    let LX := schemeOpenRestriction X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    let LY := schemeOpenRestriction Y W
    let K := (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I
    schemeMVRestrictionLocalizationChain X Y h W I =
      LY.mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).inv.app
            ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((F.mapHomotopyCategoryFactors (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).inv.app I)) ≫
      (LY.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app
          ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((schemeMVHomotopyOpenRestriction h W).hom.app K) ≫
        G.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app ((LX.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K)) ≫
      G.rightDerivedFunctor.map (LX.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app K) ≫
      G.rightDerivedFunctor.map
        (LX.mapDerivedCategory.map ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).hom.app I))

proof.text: Expand the four-map chain and complex direct-image localization unit using [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-restriction-localization-chain] and [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data].

Use Mathlib Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh_hom_app for both exact restrictions. On quotient objects the quotient comparison components and mapHomotopyCategoryFactors are identities. Functors preserve identities; cancel the X-restriction hom factor to identify its inverse factors.

Expand [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-open-counit-model]. Its homotopy restriction comparison is the quotient of the termwise complex restriction map; the composition identity factor disappears by map_id. The two remaining chains agree definitionally.
